description: Nutrition targets for training and endurance events (marathon and similar) plus science-backed daily habits. Numbers come from the ISSN position stands and IOC consensus; Huberman Lab Wiki items are labeled as such.

protein.source: ISSN protein and exercise position stand

carbsByTrainingLoad.load: very high (over 4 h/day) or marathon carb-load

dailyTargets.fat: 20-35% of energy, do not go below 20%
hydration: Baseline: about 0.5 oz per lb body weight per day (Huberman Wiki).

During exercise, roughly body weight (lb) divided by 30 = ounces every 15-20 min (Galpin equation, per Huberman Wiki). Sweat rates vary a lot, so weigh before and after a session: 1 lb lost is about 16-24 oz fluid to replace.

marathonPlan.carbLoad: 8-12 g/kg/day for the 36-48 h before the race (ISSN). Choose low-fiber carbs: white rice, pasta, potatoes, bread, oats, bananas.
marathonPlan.preRace: 1-4 g/kg carbs 1-4 h before, low fat and fiber, familiar foods only.

duringRace.over150min: up to 90 g/h using glucose:fructose (2:1) sources; train the gut to tolerate it
duringRace.fluid: drink to thirst; avoid over-drinking (hyponatremia risk)

marathonPlan.recovery: 1.0-1.2 g/kg carbs/h for the first 4 h if another hard session is within 8 h, plus 20-40 g protein. Otherwise normal meals are fine.
marathonPlan.gutTraining: Practise the exact race-day carb dose in long runs for 4-8 weeks before the event.

strengthTraining.timing: Total daily intake matters far more than the 'anabolic window'. A protein-containing meal within a few hours either side of training is sufficient.
sources: ISSN protein and exercise position stand

hubermanProtocols.note: Source: PatrykWajs/Huberman-Lab-Wiki (AI summaries). Claims graded below.

items.claim: Wait 90-120 min after waking before caffeine
items.evidence: plausible, little direct trial evidence; low cost to try

items.claim: Protein has a higher thermic effect (about 20-30% of its calories) than carbs (5-10%) or fat (0-3%)
Higher fiber intake associated with more deep sleep
6-8 h eating window raises growth hormone
items.evidence: weak for outcomes; adherence and total protein matter more

items.claim: When calories and protein match, diet style has similar fat-loss results; adherence predicts success

items.evidence: reasonable; helps sleep quality for many people

budgetNutrition.note: Figures are rounded from published 2026 price roundups and vary by store; recompute with local prices and the edible-yield figures in data/ingredients.json (bone-in cuts lose 50-60% of purchase weight to bone, skin and cook loss).
levers: Buy leg quarters, drumsticks or family-pack thighs, then freeze what will not be eaten in 3-4 days.
Replace 2-4 meals per week with lentil chili, egg-and-rice, or tuna-rice bowls.
Buy oats, rice, lentils and beans in 5-25 lb bags.
Frozen vegetables cost less and lose few nutrients.
Use whey only if you already own it; eggs, Greek yogurt and milk cost less per gram of protein.
